primary_prediction: The equal-block outgoing-minus-incoming success difference remains positive under fresh uniform 24-cell non-port injuries at 2048 updates.
primary_endpoint: Strict both-cue margin >0.25, using last-32 mean ports.
primary_units: Eight exposed blocks; all 64 previously selected failed states, with 16 paired injury/read draws per case.
controls: incoming with original-injury edge deletions only
secondary_contrasts: unchanged signed-transfer choice minus constant and unsigned choices
failure_condition: A zero or negative primary point estimate fails the directional prediction in this development panel. Sampling uncertainty is reported and is not an unplanned significance gate.
positive_interpretation: Development support for transfer within this selected cohort and injury law. No general boundary or sign-specific mechanism is established.
negative_interpretation: Preserve the failure and narrow the rewrite-benefit claim; do not tune mask selection, scoring, diagnosis or time budget to recover a positive result.
boundary: Fixed packet, observed read mask, task rule, geometry, native reader, supplied cues, reset/noise law, fixed settling/amplification resources.
conditional_dependence: Mask/noise shared across records and histories; paired founders share their native context. Related reads are not independent inference units.
exposure: Source states and earlier fixed-injury outcomes known; new masks, read namespace, analysis and prediction fixed before new native outcomes. Hashes establish provenance only.
